prettified_copies.note: All line numbers in the 2026-10-19 assessment, the gap table and open-claude-ui-v2-claims.json refer to these prettified copies (one declaration per line), not to the minified originals above. The recorded sha256 values reproduce with prettier 3.9.10 and the recorded command (verified 2026-10-20: file argument, --no-config, and stdin all give the same hash). The repo-pinned prettier 3.5.3 reflows ~300 nested :not()/:is() selector lines in the WEB file (different hash, same line count) but leaves every referenced line unchanged. To re-check a line number: regenerate with prettier 3.9.10 and compare the hash, or regenerate with any prettier 3.x and search for the quoted text.

files.command: npx -y prettier@3.9.10 --no-config --parser css --print-width 200 <original>   # prettier 3.9.10 (what `npx prettier@3` resolved to on 2026-10-19)
